Context: 5. Monthly subscription and amount of Insurance Cover:-

- (c) When there is no nomination even for GPF /CPF, the amount will be paid in equal shares to the widow/ widows, minor sons and unmarried daughters. In the case of minor sons and daughters, their mother, who is not a Muslim lady will be deemed to be the natural guardian and their shares can be paid to the mother without production of guardianship certificate. Guardianship certificate is necessary in the case of Muslims. In the absence of any of the above members, payment will be made in equal shares to
